requirements.text: Professional experience building and deploying production-grade software, ideally AI-powered or agentic systems
Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or another language used to build AI applications
Practical understanding of harness engineering (infrastructure, context, tools, permissions, controls, feedback for AI agents)
Experience building or working with agent loops (planning, tool selection, execution, observation, reflection, recovery, termination)
Familiarity with graph-based orchestration, state machines, and multi-step workflows for agents, tools, and human approvals
Experience designing evaluation systems for AI applications (benchmarks, regression suites, model-graded evals, human review, production monitoring)
Understanding of trade-offs in prompts, context management, memory, retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, and model selection
Experience instrumenting AI systems to trace decisions, inspect intermediate states, measure quality, and diagnose failures
Strong knowledge of APIs, distributed systems, databases, cloud infrastructure, and modern software-development practices
Experience collaborating directly with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional delivery teams
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining AI behavior, limitations, risks, and trade-offs
Ability to travel occasionally for client workshops or on-site delivery, where required
Experience with agent frameworks, workflow engines, coding agents, or custom model-orchestration systems
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud
Claude Certified Architect - Foundations or Professional certification (or equivalent)
